01 / THIS IS FORCE RACING
WE DON’T JUST
STUDY IT.
WE BUILD IT.

We are the Formula Student team of Kakatiya Institute of Technology & Science, Warangal.

Established in 2009, Force Racing brings students from the classroom to the workshop. We design, manufacture and compete with formula-style race cars in national and international Formula Student competitions.

Meet the force
2009
Our story began
60
Members in our team story
01
Shared pursuit
02 / BUILT TO COMPETE
IDEAS BECOME
MACHINES.

Every chassis carries the thinking, making and persistence of the students behind it.

THE 2026 CHAPTER
FR 26

SUPRA SAE India 2026

Explore our car history
FR 26 · Original team photography
03 / MORE THAN THE MACHINE
ONE TEAM.
EVERY DETAIL.

Our mission is to develop industry-ready engineers through rigorous technical execution, business practice and project management. Primarily from Mechanical Engineering, our team learns by taking responsibility for the whole car.

Our alumni have progressed into high-performance motorsport, including Formula 1, engineering consultancy and other engineering sectors.

THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE MACHINE
MANY MINDS.
ONE FORCE.

Students. Engineers. Teammates. We turn shared ambition into something we can take to the track.

A WORKSHOP. A PROVING GROUND.
THE CAR IS
ONLY THE
BEGINNING.

Established in 2009, our team story describes 60 students, primarily from Mechanical Engineering.

Each year, we design, manufacture and compete with a formula-style race car. Along the way we learn to connect technical execution with structured business and project management.

Our mission is to develop industry-ready engineers. Alumni have progressed into high-performance motorsport, including Formula 1, engineering consultancy and diverse engineering sectors.

An explanation of what our forms collect and how your information is used.

What we collect

Our on-site forms ask for your name and email address, your message, and any optional contact or organization details you choose to provide. Registration requests also require a mobile number and college or institution. We record your consent and a submission reference. Do not send card numbers, bank details, identity documents or other sensitive information.

Why we use it

Force Racing uses your information to respond to contact, partnership and contribution enquiries, and to manage sim racing registration requests. A registration request does not confirm a place or payment. The team confirms next steps separately.

Who receives it

Submissions are stored in the team’s configured Cloudflare service. Approved Force Racing organizers may receive the details through Telegram alerts and access them in the team’s private administration area. When enabled, Cloudflare Turnstile checks help protect forms from automated abuse.

Retention and your choices

Retention is controlled by the team’s service configuration; no fixed retention period is stated here. To ask how long your details are retained, request access or correction, or request deletion, email team.force.racing.kitsw@gmail.com. You may contact the team directly instead of using a form.

The Google Form alternative

The event poster links to a Google Form that requires Google sign-in. Google’s service and the form organizer’s settings govern information entered there. The Google Form is separate from this site’s enquiry system; its notifications are not integrated here. We have not verified its submission or payment process.

When forms are unavailable

A static preview cannot receive submissions. Forms remain unavailable until the team’s receiving service is connected and enabled. Entered details are not saved in this browser by this website. A successful on-site submission is shown only when the receiving service returns a receipt reference.

What we collect

Our on-site forms ask for your name and email address, your message, and any optional contact or organization details you choose to provide. Force Racing uses your information to respond to contact, partnership and contribution enquiries, and to manage sim racing registration requests. A registration request does not confirm a place or payment. The team confirms next steps separately.

Who receives it

Submissions are stored in the team’s configured Cloudflare service. Approved Force Racing organizers may receive the details through Telegram alerts and access them in the team’s private administration area. When enabled, Cloudflare Turnstile checks help protect forms from automated abuse.

Retention and your choices

Retention is controlled by the team’s service configuration; no fixed retention period is stated here. To ask how long your details are retained, request access or correction, or request deletion, email team.force.racing.kitsw@gmail.com. You may contact the team directly instead of using a form.

The Google Form alternative

The event poster links to a Google Form that requires Google sign-in. Google’s service and the form organizer’s settings govern information entered there. Established in 2009, our team story describes 60 students, primarily from Mechanical Engineering.

Each year, we design, manufacture and compete with a formula-style race car. Along the way we learn to connect technical execution with structured business and project management.

Our mission is to develop industry-ready engineers. Alumni have progressed into high-performance motorsport, including Formula 1, engineering consultancy and diverse engineering sectors.

YOUR INFORMATION
PRIVACY &
YOUR DATA.

An explanation of what our forms collect and how your information is used.

What we collect

Our on-site forms ask for your name and email address, your message, and any optional contact or organization details you choose to provide. Registration requests also require a mobile number and college or institution. We record your consent and a submission reference. Do not send card numbers, bank details, identity documents or other sensitive information.

Why we use it

Force Racing uses your information to respond to contact, partnership and contribution enquiries, and to manage sim racing registration requests. A registration request does not confirm a place or payment. The team confirms next steps separately.

Who receives it

Submissions are stored in the team’s configured Cloudflare service. Approved Force Racing organizers may receive the details through Telegram alerts and access them in the team’s private administration area. When enabled, Cloudflare Turnstile checks help protect forms from automated abuse.

Retention and your choices

Retention is controlled by the team’s service configuration; no fixed retention period is stated here. To ask how long your details are retained, request access or correction, or request deletion, email team.force.racing.kitsw@gmail.com. You may contact the team directly instead of using a form.

The Google Form alternative

The event poster links to a Google Form that requires Google sign-in. Google’s service and the form organizer’s settings govern information entered there. The Google Form is separate from this site’s enquiry system; its notifications are not integrated here. We have not verified its submission or payment process.

When forms are unavailable

A static preview cannot receive submissions. Forms remain unavailable until the team’s receiving service is connected and enabled. Entered details are not saved in this browser by this website. A successful on-site submission is shown only when the receiving service returns a receipt reference.
